main_text.l: opponimus, ut, si fuga tuta non
bendus est: quod illud jus non
ex acie fugere, stationem sibi ab

marginalia.note: Tiraq. de Nobil.c. 20. n.63. aliique ibidem.
1. 3. D. just. & jur. § jus autem gentium.
Instit.jur. nat.gent. civil.Init. Instit. in fin. de libertin.

page.notes: The first word of the page is doubtful (possibly "in" or "su"); "recte" is read from a worn letter. The last margin reference is partly cut off at the foot of the visible part and is marked [?]. The first two lines of the page are set in roman, with the paragraph continuing from the previous page. The first note's top word is cut off at the top of the scan and is read as "Constit." with uncertainty; the final word of the last note is doubtful ("libertin." may be "bertin." with a superscript). The last line ends with "ab", which is printed as the start of the next line on the cut-off part of the page.
